title: Talk on “Career Opportunities in the IC Design Industry”
content:
Talk on “Career Opportunities in the IC Design Industry”

 
Organizing Department Name: ECE Title of the event: Talk on “Career Opportunities in the IC Design Industry” Date: 26th April 2021 Venue: ATME College of Engineering Resource person/Guest: Sunil Kumar H V, Designated Partner, https://www.linkedin.com/in/sunil-kumar-hv-0b103415/ Audience: 6th and 4th Semester students of ATMECE, Mysore Brief Description about the event:  The objective of this talk is to introduce undergraduate students to the various opportunities in the VLSI industry. The IC Design industry offers the largest number of employment opportunities to undergraduates from Electronics based branches. Proper preparation from the student’s parts can make them employable in the IC Design Industry. Therefore, opening up a dearth of opportunities for the students. The talk will provide students an overview of the industry from Mr. Sunil Kumar, who has been in the IC Industry since past 15+ years in Industry. He has worked in various roles as Engineer, Building Teams Across Domains in VLSI, in Leadership & Management, in Sales & Marketing, in Finance. It is a very good opportunity for students to learn and collect information from a Professional of the IC Industry. Chief Patrons: Sri. Arun Kumar L. Chairman, ATMECE, Mysuru Sri. Shivashankar K. Hon. Secretary, ATMECE, Mysuru Sri. Veeresh  R. Hon. Treasurer, ATMECE, Mysuru Patron: Dr. L. Basavaraj Principal, ATMECE, Mysuru Convener: Dr. Mahesh P. K. HoD, ECE Department, ATMECE, Mysuru Coordinators: Mr. Abhilash G. Assistant Professor, ECE Department, ATMECE, Mysuru Report on Webinar series IC Design Industry
